text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":3,"unit":"cats","kind":"count","span":"He has 3 cats"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3 times as many dogs as cats"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"rabbits","kind":"count","span":"2 fewer rabbits than dogs"},{"id":"q4","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"three times the number of fish as rabbits"},{"id":"q5","value":0.333333333333,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"gerbils that's 1/3 the number of fish"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"number of dogs, 3 times the cats"},{"op":"sub","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"number of rabbits, 2 fewer than the dogs"},{"op":"mul","args":["q4","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"number of fish, 3 times the rabbits"},{"op":"mul","args":["q5","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"number of gerbils, 1/3 of the fish"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s5","note":"cats plus dogs"},{"op":"add","args":["s5","s2"],"out":"s6","note":"add rabbits"},{"op":"add","args":["s6","s3"],"out":"s7","note":"add fish"},{"op":"add","args":["s7","s4"],"out":"s8","note":"add gerbils for the total number of pets"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"how many pets Larry has in total"},"dismissed":[]}
